# SpanSet Indonesia

> High-performance lifting slings, height safety harnesses, load control systems, and premium safety training infrastructure in Indonesia.

Operating under world-class manufacturing standards, SpanSet Indonesia delivers critical industrial safety solutions designed to protect personnel and secure heavy cargo across maritime, construction, defense, and oil & gas sectors.

## Core Offerings

* **Lifting Slings & Cargo Netting:** Heavy-duty web slings, roundslings, and specialized high-capacity hoisting setups optimized for safe rigging and crane operations.
* **Height Safety & Fall Protection:** Premium safety harnesses, energy-absorbing lanyards, fall arrest blocks, and anchor point installations engineered to mitigate risk during elevated operations.
* **Load Control & Lashings:** Advanced ratchet tie-downs, transport lashing belts, and custom securement systems engineered for safe land, sea, and air cargo logistics.
* **Safety Training & Certification:** Hands-on professional instruction specializing in work-at-height safety protocols, rescue management, and rig inspection certifications compliant with strict safety regulations.

## Technical Specifications & Compliance

* **Standards Certification:** Products engineered and certified to meet stringent European (EN) standards, Australian Standards (AS), and global ISO safety frameworks.
* **Traceability:** Full item-level serial tracking and compliance certification available across the entire product pipeline to assist corporate safety compliance audits.
